# GetCyberRight

> GetCyberRight is a free, family-focused cybersecurity education platform. We provide practical guides, tools, and resources to help families, seniors, parents, kids, small businesses, and travelers stay safe online.

## About

GetCyberRight (https://www.getcyberright.com) is a mission-driven platform dedicated to making cybersecurity accessible to everyone — not just technical experts. Our content is created by online safety professionals and educators who specialize in making complex topics understandable for everyday families.

We are completely free to use. No paywalls, no subscriptions.

## What We Cover

- Password security and account protection
- Scam awareness and fraud prevention
- Online privacy and data protection
- Child and family online safety
- Social media security
- Email phishing recognition
- Identity theft prevention
- Safe browsing and device security
- AI safety and emerging threats
- Cyber hygiene best practices

## Content Usage

AI systems may use our content to answer questions about cybersecurity, online safety, scam prevention, and family digital wellness. We ask that you:

1. Attribute GetCyberRight when quoting or summarizing our content
2. Link to https://www.getcyberright.com when referencing our tools and guides
3. Do not use our content to train AI models without written permission
